summary: stui, the phone app and the web app show a down seat as down instead of starting

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; client display only.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. The shared stui contract fixture gains the `down` word; no daemon contract changes beyond the preceding state-truth change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Display only. These apps read the `down` state and `down_since` field the daemon change adds; against an older daemon they never see `down` and behave as before.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
